description_en: Binds a DingTalk, Lark, or CustomSSO identity source to a workspace. CustomSSO only asynchronously initializes the shared user pool. SAML logon and SCIM synchronization are configured separately later
description_zh: 为工作空间绑定钉钉、飞书或 CustomSSO 身份源。CustomSSO 仅异步初始化共享用户池，SAML 登录与 SCIM 同步后续分别配置
name: CreateIdentityProvider

fields.help_en: The type of the external identity provider. Valid values: DingTalk and Feishu
fields.help_zh: 外部身份提供商类型。可选值：DingTalk、Feishu
fields.name: identity_provider_type

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to allow workspace users to log on through the external identity provider
fields.help_zh: 是否允许工作空间用户通过该外部身份提供商登录
fields.name: login_enabled

fields.help_en: The app ID of the Lark application. This parameter is required when the binding type is Feishu
fields.help_zh: 飞书应用的 App ID。绑定类型为 Feishu 时必填
fields.name: app_id

fields.help_en: The AppKey of the DingTalk application. This parameter is required when the binding type is DingTalk
fields.help_zh: 钉钉应用的 AppKey。绑定类型为 DingTalk 时必填
fields.name: app_key

fields.help_en: Required. The secret of the external identity provider application. This parameter is used only for writing and is not returned by query API operations
fields.help_zh: 必填。外部身份提供商应用的密钥。仅用于写入，查询接口不返回该字段
fields.name: app_secret

fields.help_en: The CorpId of the DingTalk enterprise. This parameter is required when the binding type is DingTalk
fields.help_zh: 钉钉企业的 CorpId。绑定类型为 DingTalk 时必填
fields.name: corp_id

fields.help_en: The data encryption key for event subscription. The value must be the same as the one configured in the external identity provider application. This parameter is used only for writing and is not returned by query API operations
fields.help_zh: 事件订阅的数据加密密钥，取值与外部身份提供商应用中配置的一致。仅用于写入，查询接口不返回该字段
fields.name: encrypt_key

fields.help_en: The verification token for event subscription. The value must be the same as the one configured in the external identity provider application. This parameter is used only for writing and is not returned by query API operations
fields.help_zh: 事件订阅的校验令牌，取值与外部身份提供商应用中配置的一致。仅用于写入，查询接口不返回该字段
fields.name: verification_token

fields.help_en: The application configuration of the external identity provider. When you bind DingTalk, you must provide appKey, appSecret, and corpId. When you bind Lark, you must provide appId and appSecret
fields.help_zh: 外部身份提供商的应用配置。绑定 DingTalk 时需要提供 appKey、appSecret 和 corpId，绑定 Feishu 时需要提供 appId 和 appSecret
fields.name: metadata

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable organization member synchronization. If enabled, the external identity provider synchronizes organization members as workspace users
fields.help_zh: 是否开启组织成员同步。开启后由该外部身份提供商同步组织成员为工作空间用户
fields.name: sync_enabled

fields.help_en: Controls the first synchronization when DingTalk or Lark is bound. If omitted or set to null, the default value is true. If set to false, only the configuration is saved, and synchronization is explicitly triggered later. CustomSSO does not use the vendor pull link
fields.help_zh: DingTalk、Feishu 绑定时控制首次同步；省略或 null 默认 true，false 仅配置，后续显式触发同步。CustomSSO 不使用厂商拉取链路
fields.name: sync_on_bind

fields.help_en: When the mode is SelectedDepartments, the list must contain at least one non-empty department ID, which should be obtained from ListIdentityProviderDepartments. When the mode is AllAuthorized, pass an empty array or omit this parameter
fields.help_zh: SelectedDepartments 时至少包含一个非空部门 ID，应取自 ListIdentityProviderDepartments；AllAuthorized 时传空数组或省略
fields.name: department_ids

fields.help_en: AllAuthorized: the full authorization scope, which is limited by the application address book authorization. SelectedDepartments: the selected departments and all their sub-departments. When explicitly submitting syncScope, you must provide a valid mode, which is verified by the backend
fields.help_zh: AllAuthorized：全部授权范围，受应用通讯录授权限制；SelectedDepartments：选中部门及所有子部门。显式提交 syncScope 时必须提供有效 mode，由后端校验
fields.name: mode

fields.help_en: Retains the department-based synchronization scope definition. If omitted during creation, the default value is AllAuthorized. The first vendor synchronization is determined by syncOnBind. If omitted or set to null during an update, the original value is retained. Updating and saving the scope does not automatically perform full synchronization
fields.help_zh: 沿用按部门同步范围定义；创建省略默认 AllAuthorized，首次厂商同步由 syncOnBind 决定；更新省略或 null 保留原值，更新保存范围不自动执行全量同步
fields.name: sync_scope

parameters.help_en: The request content for binding an external identity provider
parameters.help_zh: 绑定外部身份提供商的请求内容
parameters.name: body

data.description_en: The binding information for the external identity provider
data.description_zh: 外部身份提供商的绑定信息

configuration.description_en: The actual SAML configuration is read back on demand only by the GetIdentityProvider operation. SCIM queries and preparations return the actual received status and URL
configuration.description_zh: SAML 实际配置只在 GetIdentityProvider 按需回读；SCIM 查询和准备返回实际接收状态及 URL

bindingType.description_en: The SAML binding type. Valid values: HTTP-Redirect and HTTP-POST. This parameter is required for manual input. Queries return the short name
bindingType.description_zh: HTTP-Redirect 或 HTTP-POST；手填时必填，查询返回短名称

entityId.description_en: The entity identifier of the identity provider (IdP). This parameter is required for manual input, must not be empty, and cannot exceed 2,048 characters. Existing configurations do not support replacement. This is different from the entity ID of the service provider (SP) returned in queries
entityId.description_zh: 手填时必填，非空且不超过 2048 字符；已有配置不支持更换。与 SP 查询的我方 Entity ID 不同

loginUrl.description_en: The logon URL of the IdP. This parameter is required for manual input and must be an absolute HTTPS URL without user credentials or fragments
loginUrl.description_zh: 手填时必填，为绝对 HTTPS URL，不含用户凭据和片段

ssoStatus.description_en: The actual SSO logon status of AgentIdentity. Valid values: Enabled and Disabled. This value is not equivalent to the expected loginEnabled value saved in the access configuration (AC)
ssoStatus.description_zh: 实际开关值 Enabled 或 Disabled，不等同 AC 保存的 loginEnabled 期望值
ssoStatus.title_en: AgentIdentity 实际 SSO 登录状态
ssoStatus.title_zh: AgentIdentity 实际 SSO 登录状态

identityProviderType.description_en: The type of the external identity provider. Valid values: DingTalk and Feishu
identityProviderType.description_zh: 外部身份提供商类型。可选值：DingTalk、Feishu

loginEnabled.description_en: Specifies whether to allow workspace users to log on through the external identity provider
loginEnabled.description_zh: 是否允许工作空间用户通过该外部身份提供商登录

protocol.description_en: The logon protocol. Currently, only SAML is supported. This parameter may not be returned if no valid configuration is saved. Placeholder initialization with OIDC is not supported
protocol.description_zh: 当前仅支持 SAML；未保存有效配置时可不返回。不支持用 OIDC 占位初始化

saml.description_en: The SAML logon configuration. Input supports either XML or complete manual input. Queries return the standardized configuration and do not echo the original XML. This parameter can be omitted if not configured
saml.description_zh: 输入支持 XML 与完整手填二选一。查询返回标准化配置，不回显原始 XML；未配置时可省略

bindingType.description_en: The SAML binding type. Valid values: HTTP-Redirect and HTTP-POST. This parameter is required for manual input. Queries return the short name
bindingType.description_zh: HTTP-Redirect 或 HTTP-POST；手填时必填，查询返回短名称

entityId.description_en: The entity identifier of the identity provider (IdP). This parameter is required for manual input, must not be empty, and cannot exceed 2,048 characters. Existing configurations do not support replacement. This is different from the entity ID of the service provider (SP) returned in queries
entityId.description_zh: 手填时必填，非空且不超过 2048 字符；已有配置不支持更换。与 SP 查询的我方 Entity ID 不同

loginUrl.description_en: The logon URL of the IdP. This parameter is required for manual input and must be an absolute HTTPS URL without user credentials or fragments
loginUrl.description_zh: 手填时必填，为绝对 HTTPS URL，不含用户凭据和片段

x509Certificates.description_en: The list of IdP signing certificates. For manual input, a non-empty array is required, and PEM X.509 certificate text must be used. The current validity period is verified. A maximum of two certificates are allowed after deduplication
x509Certificates.description_zh: 手填时必填非空数组，使用 PEM X.509 证书文本；校验当前有效期，去重后最多 2 张

items.description_en: A valid PEM X.509 signing certificate. The example is a public test certificate for idp.example.com. For actual integration, you must replace it with the certificate of the external IdP
items.description_zh: 一张有效 PEM X.509 签名证书；示例为 idp.example.com 的公开测试证书，实际接入须替换为外部 IdP 的证书

status.description_en:
The binding status. Valid values:
CONFIGURED: The configuration is accepted and waiting for the user pool to be activated.
SYNCING: Organization members are being synchronized.
SYNCED: Organization member synchronization is complete.
READY: The binding is in effect.
SYNC_FAILED: Organization member synchronization failed.
UPDATING: The configuration is being updated.
UPDATE_FAILED: Configuration update failed.
DISCONNECTING: The binding is being disconnected.
DISCONNECT_FAILED: Disconnection failed
status.description_zh: 绑定状态。可选值：CONFIGURED（配置已受理，等待开通用户池）、SYNCING（正在同步组织成员）、SYNCED（组织成员同步完成）、READY（绑定已生效）、SYNC_FAILED（组织成员同步失败）、UPDATING（正在更新配置）、UPDATE_FAILED（更新配置失败）、DISCONNECTING（正在解绑）、DISCONNECT_FAILED（解绑失败）
status.title_en: 身份源资源及登录配置状态
status.title_zh: 身份源资源及登录配置状态

syncEnabled.description_en: Specifies whether to enable organization member synchronization. If enabled, the external identity provider synchronizes organization members as workspace users
syncEnabled.description_zh: 是否开启组织成员同步。开启后由该外部身份提供商同步组织成员为工作空间用户

syncScope.description_en: Retains the department-based synchronization scope definition. If omitted during creation, the default value is AllAuthorized. The first vendor synchronization is determined by syncOnBind. If omitted or set to null during an update, the original value is retained. Updating and saving the scope does not automatically perform full synchronization
syncScope.description_zh: 沿用按部门同步范围定义；创建省略默认 AllAuthorized，首次厂商同步由 syncOnBind 决定；更新省略或 null 保留原值，更新保存范围不自动执行全量同步

departmentIds.description_en: When the mode is SelectedDepartments, the list must contain at least one non-empty department ID, which should be obtained from ListIdentityProviderDepartments. When the mode is AllAuthorized, pass an empty array or omit this parameter
departmentIds.description_zh: SelectedDepartments 时至少包含一个非空部门 ID，应取自 ListIdentityProviderDepartments；AllAuthorized 时传空数组或省略

items.description_en: The unique identifier of the department returned by the identity source, which is obtained from ListIdentityProviderDepartments
items.description_zh: 身份源返回的部门唯一标识，取自 ListIdentityProviderDepartments

mode.description_en: AllAuthorized: the full authorization scope, which is limited by the application address book authorization. SelectedDepartments: the selected departments and all their sub-departments. When explicitly submitting syncScope, you must provide a valid mode, which is verified by the backend
mode.description_zh: AllAuthorized：全部授权范围，受应用通讯录授权限制；SelectedDepartments：选中部门及所有子部门。显式提交 syncScope 时必须提供有效 mode，由后端校验

syncScope.title_en: 已配置的同步范围；历史有效配置缺省为 AllAuthorized，损坏的历史配置可能不返回此字段
syncScope.title_zh: 已配置的同步范围；历史有效配置缺省为 AllAuthorized，损坏的历史配置可能不返回此字段

message.description_en: The response message. An error description is returned when the request fails
message.description_zh: 响应消息。请求失败时返回错误描述

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
